title: Beanconqueror Brew Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:brew
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by recipe_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Beanconqueror brew data has stopped arriving for a given recipe name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per recipe name and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your Beanconqueror brew feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
